A [[Gender|female]] '''individual''' was the [[Parent|mother]] of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], a [[human]] male<ref name="Kenobi III" /> from [[Stewjon]].<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> Obi-Wan had vague memories of his mother, specifically the shawl that she wore.<ref name="Kenobi III" />
